name: monoAI technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: monoAI technology Co., Ltd. provides event services in the metaverse and in extended reality (XR), plus related offerings. A key product is XR CLOUD, a platform for building immersive virtual environments using large-scale VR space-sharing technology. The company also develops online games, systems and communication middleware, and works on software quality assurance solutions. The firm has its base in Kobe and dates from 2013.
